subject.title: fix(ui): neutralize Usage CSV text cells [AI]

question: Should Usage CSV exports prioritize spreadsheet formula neutralization by prefixing formula-leading text labels with an apostrophe, accepting the changed literal cell value for those labels?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and proven, but whether altered raw export content is acceptable is a maintainer-owned compatibility policy decision.

options.title: Approve the safety policy
options.body: Accept apostrophe-prefixed formula-leading text labels so spreadsheet imports treat untrusted labels as text.

options.title: Define another export contract
options.body: Specify a different supported representation or export mode if preserving exact raw label bytes is more important for existing consumers.

recommendation.title: Approve the safety policy
recommendation.body: Accept apostrophe-prefixed formula-leading text labels so spreadsheet imports treat untrusted labels as text.

likelyOwner.reason: The protected maintainer label leaves the remaining compatibility-policy choice with repository ownership.
